caption: The drawing depicts a figurine of a woman standing on a rectangular, marbled brown and beige base. The woman is dressed in a long dress with a fitted red bodice featuring green trim and buttons down the center, and a full, conical skirt decorated with horizontal bands and stylized, multicolored floral and scroll motifs in red, green, yellow, and blue. The upper part of the dress, around the shoulders and neckline, is green, and there is a yellow fan-like design right below the bodice. The woman's right arm is extended outward with the palm up, and her left arm is bent, holding a smaller doll-sized figure with similar facial features and attire, dressed in a red dress with yellow accents. The main figure has short dark hair, simple facial features, and light brown skin. The composition centers the figure, with the colors of the dress and patterns drawing the eye, set against a plain, light beige background.
title: Nuestra Senora
